answers.reason: The senate deals with central university strategy, whereas the research associate only participates in one body directly matching their specific duties.
Budget planning is the responsibility of the central administration and chancellor, not the research associate.
Selecting candidates for professorships does not fall under the research associate's specific tasks of doctoral work, teaching a few courses, and assisting in projects.
The faculty council is led by the dean and handles broad faculty affairs rather than the specific day-to-day matters of the research associate.
The study commission handles high-level degree programme changes, which is outside the research associate's specific domain.
Examination matters are the responsibility of the faculty administrative officer and the vice president for studies, not the research associate.
The research associate works on research projects, making the internal research funding round for small project grants the one place where their matters are decided.
Members only participate in one body, and the research associate's primary role in research projects aligns more closely with project funding or lab work than rewriting degree programme descriptions.
Each member participates in only one body, and the research associate is primarily tied to research projects rather than managing teaching laboratories.
Planning the orientation week for new students is a student matter and does not match the research associate's duties.
